names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Григорий (Сербаринов), протоиерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Григория пресвитера, прмцц. Августы и Марии , мц. Агриппины (1938).»

attestations.note: The day’s tenth entry. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS, no life page standing behind any of this company. The line names four people and all four are in this draft. The name page’s grade for this person is «протоиерей». A Cyrillic grep for «Сербаринов» over every `saint.json` in the corpus returns nothing, `ls -d saints/grego*` nothing of this man, and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page carries no troparion and no kontakion under this name; the three it prints belong to the day’s own feasts and to one of its icons.
